security.magicLinksHint: Sign in with a secure link sent to your email.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose how you hear about each kind of update. Critical account emails are always sent.

data.title: Your data

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Permanently delete your account. Your account and profile details are removed. Your shared booking history, including any open offers, is kept but de-identified. This cannot be undone.
delete.hireOrdersNote: Signed hire orders you already agreed to are kept for the organization's records.
